tasks.title: Part A: scheduled worker-local miss consults the host coordinator before terminal deny
tasks.objective: Per decision 0116: at the scheduled branch tool-permission-gate.ts:396, when currentAutonomousAllowedToolRules() does not match, consult the existing host coordinator reviewed-rule decision (which holds the agent's reviewed durable capability + command rules and semanticCapabilityDefinitions) before the denial becomes terminal. Do NOT widen the worker set with configured SDK allowedTools (PERM-2 bypass). No matcher/projection/resolveCapabilityRules changes.
acceptance_criteria: A scheduled/autonomous run whose agent is host-granted google.sheets.values.get (definition present) authorizes its gog command via the host coordinator instead of a terminal deny.
An ungranted capability/command still denies (host denies too); the deny remains terminal and routes to the SCHED-6 pause flow.
Browser and other canonical capabilities remain allowed (regression).
currentAutonomousAllowedToolRules() is NOT widened with configured SDK allowedTools; authority stays host-reviewed (PERM-2 preserved).
verify_commands: npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts apps/core/test/unit/runner apps/core/test/unit/shared

required_tests.id: tool permission gate > scheduled worker-local miss authorizes a host-granted capability command via the host coordinator
required_tests.command: VITEST_JUNIT=1 FORGE_TEST_ID={id} npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts {path} --outputFile {report}

tasks.reviewer_focus: PERM-2 boundary preserved (no worker self-grant); ungranted still denies; host round-trip only on the miss path.

tasks.title: Part B: one plain-language notification per denied-tool pause
tasks.objective: Collapse a denied-tool pause to a single user-facing notification: at notifySchedulerTerminalRunState (execution-notifications.ts:361-405) suppress the terminal card fully when the setup card owns the outcome (key on setupNotified + SETUP_REQUIRED_PAUSE_REASON; drop the fragile denial re-parse; stop the secondary send), and rewrite the setup-story copy mobile-first. Keep the one-tap approve when grantable.
acceptance_criteria: One denied-tool pause emits exactly one user-facing notification (no duplicate terminal card render).
The single message is mobile-first plain language (no Run outcome: Died / Blockers (N) / Triggering step jargon).
A grantable denial still surfaces the one-tap approve.

required_tests.id: scheduler terminal notifications > a denied-tool pause sends exactly one notification and no duplicate terminal card
required_tests.command: VITEST_JUNIT=1 FORGE_TEST_ID={id} npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts {path} --outputFile {report}

tasks.reviewer_focus: No over-suppression of genuinely distinct messages; copy is plain language.
